name: f4-reference-profiles-graph
description: Renders this folder's 'first m real sessions establish a constant reference, compared with later real sessions' figure for one real subject of one study, as a standalone HTML page, one chart card per feature. Reads GDX_HNF_FEATURE_VALUE (F1) directly and recomputes the baseline live -- never reads or duplicates GDX_HNF_CDI_REFERENCE_VALUE, which may have been built with a different session count.
